raw_text:
Divya Krishnan
divya.krishnan.cs@gmail.com | +91 98xxxxxx12 | github.com/divyak | Coimbatore
SUMMARY
Computer Science student with a strong personal project portfolio in the MERN stack, cloud deployment
experience, and exposure to agile practices through a college developer club.
EDUCATION
B.E. Computer Science, PSG College of Technology (2023-2027), CGPA: 8.9/10
SKILLS
JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, REST APIs, Git/GitHub, AWS (EC2, S3), Jest, Agile/Scrum,
Tailwind CSS
PROJECTS
CivicConnect - Local Issue Reporting Platform
•
Full stack MERN application allowing citizens to report and track local civic issues
•
Deployed backend on AWS EC2 and frontend on Vercel; used GitHub Actions for CI/CD
•
Wrote Jest test suites for critical API endpoints
Developer Club Sprint Projects
•
Led a 4-person team through 2-week agile sprints to build 3 internal club tools using MERN
CERTIFICATIONS
AWS Academy Cloud Foundations
